summary.text: Before age 65, you can save up to the Basic Healthcare Sum, or BHS, in your MediSave Account. From 1 January 2026, it is $79,000.

details.heading: The 2026 limit
details.body: From 1 January 2026, the BHS is $79,000 for CPF members aged 65 and below.

details.heading: After age 65
details.body: Your BHS is adjusted yearly until you turn 65. When you turn 65, your applicable BHS is fixed for life.

example_phrasings: Is there a maximum amount that I can save in my MediSave Account?

sources.page_title: Is there a maximum amount that I can save in my MediSave Account?

quotes.text: You can save up to the prevailing Basic Healthcare Sum (BHS) in your MediSave Account (MA) if you have not turned age 65.
From 1 January 2026, the BHS is $79,000 for all CPF members aged 65 years and below.
The BHS applicable to you will be adjusted yearly to keep pace with rising healthcare consumption until you turn age 65.
